lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in a repetitive grid formation posterior to the gill slits. Centroids follow a roughly rectangular tessellation across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal alignment of blobs, creating a grid-like structural appearance across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light superior edge to a shadowed inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, high-luminance elongated object (remora fish) attached to the lateral surface of the pectoral fin.
